mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM falls below 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals a deteriorating labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month UNRATE change exceeds 0.5pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the 10-year Treasury yield rises by more than 50 basis points over a 3-month period, it signals a tightening of financial conditions that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month DGS10 change exceeds 50bp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in retail sales turns negative, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y RSAFS growth turns negative but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index is above 60 and the ISM prices paid index is also above 60, it signals an overheating economy with rising inflation pressures that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM and ISM_PR both above 60 but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4% and the year-over-year change in average hourly earnings is above 4%, it signals a tight labor market with rising wage pressures that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and y-o-y change in AHETPI > 4%
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and y-o-y AHETPI > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the 2-year Treasury yield is above the 10-year Treasury yield by more than 50 basis points, it signals an inverted yield curve that has historically preceded economic recessions and stock market declines, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 2s10s curve inverts by > 50bp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.
